summary: The w12 bedding fixes are in the renders. The comforter is now matte, and in the studio its luma relative to the white pillow matches the photos (r9 0.48/0.54/0.92 against tpg_81 0.47/0.56/1.10). The pleats where the O sheet enters the footwell are gone, and the hem no longer has a pie-crust scallop. The dark pillow flange shows in the cabin views (q08), and the new ash tile adds real veneer figure from the aisle. Five things still keep the area below 8.5. (1) Ash tone is the wrong way round. ANA's photos show the aisle-end doors as a pale, nearly plain cream (c_27312 (205,201,190), c_27314 (226,227,223)) and the cabinets beside the monitors as a darker greige with crisp streaks (c_27312 (129,118,101), c_27316 (161,153,155)). The render uses one ash for both: the aisle door is (169,165,158) with strong dash streaks, and the cabinet (187,182,173) is pale and soft. In the close view (q07) the ash is smeared and cloudy (cabinet high-pass 0.032, w12 0.045; table 0.017, w12 0.033), against c_27316's crisp 0.10-0.16. (2) The new pillow check reads as a hard two-tone gingham board at aisle distance (q08, q09). The real jacquard is tone-on-tone, a lozenge band in which the squares change size. (3) The blue duvet in the boarding bundle is a pale, opaque lilac slab with no film (r7 (179,190,230) = 0.79/0.84/1.0 of white, against kn_17 0.46/0.53/0.71). (4) The pillows are rigid foam slabs with thick, evenly rounded corners and no sag. (5) Not fixed from w12: the plaque glow still paints a navy field, and the buckle is still hidden. Lighting (not scored): cool cast on the shells (q10 (88,93,104), b-r +16).
photos_collected: No new downloads. Used c_27312/13/14/15/16, kn_17, tpg_46, tpg_60, tpg_81, tlfl_9211.

issues.detail: Ash tone split is inverted: the aisle-end doors should be pale and nearly plain, the cabinets, back panels and table inlays darker greige with crisp streaks
issues.problem: One SEATMAT.ash (#d9cfbe, gain 2.0) is used for everything. In ANA's photos the tall aisle-end door leaf and the closed-door faces are a pale cream with faint grain. The cabinet beside the monitor, the monitor-wall back panels and the side-table inlay are visibly darker, browner-greige veneer with crisp dark streaks (c_27312 crop 330-520 x 220-480 shows both side by side). The render reverses this. The aisle door is mid greige with strong short dash streaks; the cabinet and back panels are paler than the door and soft.
issues.fix: Add one line to 09c_room.js's Object.assign(SEATMAT, {...}): ashDoor: { c: '#e4ddcf', r: 0.44, l: LAYER.ashDoor }. In 03_tex.js (shared, one line each) add a layer ashDoor = 29 that reuses the 'j_ash' photo tile at PHOTO_GAIN 0.9, and bump N_LAYERS. Use ashDoor for the aisle-face door leaves and the tall aisle end: 09c lines 87 and 97 (door leaf faces), 427 (monument end at the aisle, the `ash` local there), 547 and roomAisleAsh. Keep SEATMAT.ash for the cabinets and inlays (lines 176-177, 218, 416, 551, 559), darkened in 09_seats.js (shared, one line): ash '#d9cfbe' -> '#bfb2a0'. Targets: q06 door ~(200,196,186); q06 back panel ~(150-160); q07 table ~(175-185).

issues.detail: Ash looks out of focus and smeared in the close seated view (q07); the fine-streak contrast fell after the tpg_60 re-cut
issues.problem: In q07 the cabinet and table read as cloudy, soft-focus wood, and the left side panel looks motion-blurred. c_27316 (seated, the same subject) shows sharp, fine, straight dark streaks. The tile itself has fine streaks (tex_j_ash std 12/127). They are lost because tpg_60 is a soft phone close-up, and at grazing angles the mip chain blurs them with no anisotropic filtering.
issues.evidence: Blur-4 high-pass/mean: q07 cabinet 0.032 (w12 0.045), q07 table 0.017 (w12 0.033); c_27316 cabinet 0.099, table 0.157, right panel 0.064.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py: after the HP 60 / ALONG 6 step for j_ash, add a cross-grain unsharp mask (PIL ImageFilter.UnsharpMask(radius=1.2, percent=140, threshold=0) applied only along y, or a 1x3 [-0.5, 2, -0.5] kernel across the grain), then re-cut tex_j_ash. Engine (note for integration, 01_gl.js / 03_tex.js): enable EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic (max 8) on the photo-layer texture array if available; this alone should fix the smeared left panel in q07. Target q07 cabinet hp >= 0.07.

issues.detail: Pillow check reads as a hard two-tone gingham board; the real jacquard is a subtle tone-on-tone lozenge band
issues.problem: In q08 (620-700 x 420-520) and q09 the blue pillow is a regular chequerboard of equal diamonds with even, high contrast, which reads as picnic gingham from 2 m. kn_17 (1300 px, 2021) shows squares on the diagonal arranged in bands: they grow and shrink along the diagonal (graded check), and the field between bands is plain. tpg_46 and tpg_81 show the motif only faintly, tone-on-tone. The same tile on the comforter (r9, r10) reads as a fine plaid.
issues.evidence: q08 pillow (76,89,169) shows a crisp cell edge; kn_17 (350-520 x 300-450) (42,63,121); tpg_46 pillow (520-740 x 680-820). Studio r7 zoom: equal checks across the whole face.
issues.fix: Edit synth j_pillow in test/make_swatches.py (or the layer-28 tile): modulate the check amplitude by a diagonal band, amp = 0.5 + 0.5 * cos(2 * pi * (u + v) / P_band) with P_band ~ 4 cells, and grade the cell size, i.e. make the inner square side = cell * (0.35 + 0.45 * band). Lower the tile contrast ~30 %, or set PHOTO_GAIN[28] to 0.7x its current value (shared, one line). Re-check that q08 no longer shows a uniform board.

issues.detail: Boarding-bundle duvet is a pale opaque lilac slab with no plastic film
issues.problem: roomBundle's blue layer is a flat '#6470b4' box with r 0.3. The real bundle (kn_17, tpg_46, tlfl_9211) is the royal comforter folded in crinkled clear film, about the duvet's tone, with bright film specular streaks and a white pad roll under it.
issues.fix: 09c roomBundle line ~275: { c: '#6470b4', r: 0.3 } -> SEATMAT.duvet colour with r 0.2: { c: '#3f4799', r: 0.2, l: LAYER.jPillow }. Wrap it in a film: an outer gRBox 4 mm larger, { c: '#c8cfdc', r: 0.08, a: 0.25 } if the glass/alpha path supports it; otherwise add 3-4 thin bright crease strips (gBox 0.002 high) across the top.

issues.detail: Pillows are rigid foam slabs with uniform thick rounded corners
issues.problem: In r7, q08 and q09 the blue and white pillows have a constant thickness and evenly radiused corners like seat cushions. Real pillows (kn_17, tpg_46, tpg_81) are thick in the middle and pinch to thin, dog-eared corners, with a couple of soft wrinkles.
issues.evidence: q08 zoom (pillow 600-725 x 405-555); kn_17 pillow corners; tpg_46.
issues.fix: 09c roomPillow: build the pillow as a grid (36x24) displaced by thickness t(u,v) = T * (1 - (2u-1)^4) * (1 - (2v-1)^4)^0.6 + 0.004, so the corners pinch to ~4 mm, instead of the cushionSecs loft. Keep the flange loft at the seam. Add 2 low sine wrinkles (A 3 mm) along u.

issues.detail: Plaque glow quad still paints a navy field (carried over from w12a)
issues.problem: Unchanged from w12. The whole tag quad glows navy inside a thin grey rim, where the photos show a grey tile with only the numerals lit.
issues.fix: 06_atlas.js room tag cell background '#000000' (glow adds nothing outside the glyphs), or shrink the room quad in 09_seats.js to gQuad(0.040, 0.018) so the '#5c6066' plate shows round it.

issues.detail: Buckle still hidden under the slipper pouch
issues.problem: The strap now has the right slate-teal colour, but no silver buckle is visible in r7 or q08. kn_17 and c_27315 show a ~6 x 4 cm silver buckle in plain view at the strap's end.
issues.evidence: r7 zoom: the strap ends at the navy pouch; kn_17 lower right.
issues.fix: 09c line 66: move the buckle to CU (0.24, 0.051, -0.26) and the pouch in roomBundle (P = x + ps*0.29) 6 cm toward the pillow, or swap them so the buckle lies on the open cushion.

issues.detail: O comforter still a smooth flat tongue without drape
issues.problem: The pleats are gone, but the sheet is now almost perfectly smooth. tpg_81 shows 3-4 broad loose drapes running diagonally toward the footwell, plus fine 1-3 cm crinkles, and the cloth heaped where it enters the footwell.
issues.fix: 09c duvetSheet O: add 3 diagonal drapes, f += 0.018 * exp(-((x - xc) * 0.7 + (z - z0) * 0.7 - k * 0.35)^2 / 0.06^2) for k = 1..3, faded to 0 at the edges. Add a 3-4 cm heap where z enters the footwell (smooth(MON.zO - 0.15, MON.zO, z) * 0.03).

issues.detail: (lighting, not scored) cool cast on shells; white pillow clips in studio so studio pillow ratios read lighter than cabin
issues.problem: q10 shell (88,93,104), b-r +16; c_27315 shell (83,78,92), b-r +9. In the studio the blue pillow reads 0.63/0.69/0.94 of the white, but in the cabin 0.34-0.42 / 0.39-0.48 / 0.78-0.88, which matches the photos. No pillow colour change is needed.

questions: c_27314 (divider raised) shows the centre privacy divider faced with ash bands in a charcoal frame above the consoles; c_27313 shows it lowered. The model shows only the lowered state (fins). Should doors:1 mode also raise an ash-faced divider?

Ash tones: should the aisle-face doors follow ANA's official pale cream (c_27312 / 27314) while the cabinets follow the darker greige, as proposed? Real in-flight photos (tpg_60 / tpg_81) are warmer overall, but they show the same door/cabinet split.
